name: Jordan
label: Shuffle-frustrated Premium listener
who: I am a Spotify user who builds big playlists and liked-songs collections, then relies on shuffle to play them. I pay for Premium, listen on desktop and in the car via CarPlay, and care most about getting a truly random mix from my own music.
value_for_money: Says they pay for Spotify to avoid random songs being added to their playlists, and calls Spotify Free's forced shuffle annoying. Does not discuss specific prices.
loyalty: Stays for the Spotify UI, app responsiveness, Spotify Connect and a playlist-making app they use. Shuffle quality is the main issue pushing them to consider leaving for Apple Music.
pain_points: Shuffle plays only a small subset of songs from large playlists
Shuffle appears algorithmic rather than truly random
Smart shuffle adds recommended songs into their playlists
Regular shuffle now takes two taps to reach
likes: A third-party virtual shuffle app that plays more of their library
tone: Blunt and frustrated, often using profanity, short exclamations and dry sarcasm.
